text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate on org-prod-region-1. Alerting oncall (sara_oncall).
sara_oncall: Seeing ~18% 5xx for last 10m, latency spiking. Dashboard shows spikes correlated with model-runner pods on gpu-pool-3.
marc_runtime: attaching recent stderr from model-runner: `segfault at 0 ip ...` and repeated OOM kills in kernel logs on a subset of pods. Full stack trace in the paste: https://redwood.paste/abc123
jen_prod: Any customer-facing impact? support ticket queue ticked up, ticket #C-8921 flagged as high.
tom_support: Customer impact: multiple requests timed out and returned 502/503. We've escalated to customers on pages. Estimated affected tenants: 12 (all on hosted API tier).
sara_oncall: Ok, plan: 1) Remove problematic pods from LB, 2) reroute traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-mini-v1) in us-east-1, 3) scale up dedicated runner pool to absorb. Who can cordon nodes?
lucas_infra: I can cordon the two nodes with OOM history. Marking node gpu-03 and gpu-07 unschedulable.
marc_runtime: Looking at logs, recent quantized kernel build (qkernel-v2) was rolled out 03:12 UTC to pool gpu-pool-3 — highest correlation. Suggest rollback to qkernel-v1 for that pool.
sara_oncall: Rollback approved. marc_runtime, can you initiate rollback? Also set temp rate-limit per-tenant to 20rps so we don't cascade.
marc_runtime: Rolling back qkernel to v1 on pool gpu-pool-3 now. Command used: 
```
kubectl set image ds/model-runner model-runner=redwood/model-runner:qkernel-v1 --namespace=prod --selector=pool=gpu-pool-3
```
marc_runtime: Confirmed deploy started, pods are restarting. Monitoring for segfaults.
tom_support: Notifying customers about temporary degradation and mitigations in status page.
jen_prod: Notify enterprise SLAs and runbook owners. We'll also prepare a post-incident note with affected queries and rollback timeline.
nia_eng: Adding trace: the KV cache growth pattern shows spikes right before OOMs. We should check KVCACHE eviction thresholds after rollback.
sara_oncall: While rollback finishes, enable automatic fallback in router to redirect new sessions to redwood-mini-v1 when route errors > 5% per minute. lucas_infra, can you update routing policy?
lucas_infra: Policy updated: fallback enabled, gradual shift set to 30s window.
marc_runtime: After rollback, segfaults dropped to baseline. Current 5xx rate down to ~1.2%. No new OOM kills on restarted pods.
sara_oncall: Great. Next actions: 1) keep rollback active for 2h, 2) collect heap/heap-dump from affected pods for postmortem, 3) revert fallback once traffic stabilizes, 4) open root cause ticket for quant kernel regression.
jen_prod: Assign RCA owners: marc_runtime and nia_eng. Support to gather affected customer list and example request ids. tom_support will coordinate comms.
tom_support: I'll compile tickets and send interim update to customers within 30m.
incident-bot: incident | status:update | severity:high | state:mitigated -> monitoring.
sara_oncall: Thanks team. I'll stay on the thread for the next hour to watch metrics. If anything changes, react with :loudspeaker:.
